title: FDMaturity
description: Information related to a Fixed Deposit (FD) at the time of maturity, including the maturity amount, interest earned, start date and maturity date.

maturityAmount.description: The total amount receivable at the end of an investment term, including the principal and accumulated interest, as per the agreed-upon rate and tenure.

interestRate.description: The percentage at which interest is to be earned on a deposit over the specified tenure.

depositStartDate.description: The date on which the Fixed Deposit (FD) is opened and the investment tenure begins.

maturityDate.description: The date on which the Fixed Deposit (FD) completes its tenure, and the principal along with the accrued interest becomes available for withdrawal or renewal.
